<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

Add an opt-in Mooncake DFS tier (e.g. 3FS) to `MooncakeStoreConnector`, so stored KV can live in a shared file system instead of, or in addition to, host memory. Builds on #42689.

## Claims

- `"enable_dfs": true` in the Mooncake config writes one DFS replica per object plus `replica_num` memory replicas (`kv_connector_extra_config`, default 1).
- `replica_num: 0` stores KV only in DFS (requires kvcache-ai/Mooncake#4637).
- Invalid setups (DFS with a non-default tenant or the cross-encoder cache, `replica_num` without DFS) fail at startup.

## Validation

- Mooncake store unit tests and pre-commit pass.
- 3FS on Mooncake main `d855a6ae`, Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct, single GPU: generate, reset the local prefix cache, generate again.

| `replica_num` | Keys with a memory replica | Store hits on 2nd request | Output tokens match |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | 0 / 33 | 528 / 537 | Yes |
| 1 | 33 / 33 | 528 / 537 | Yes |

## Details

- `enable_dfs` lives in the Mooncake JSON with other `setup()`-time options (`enable_offload`, `tenant_id`); `replica_num` lives in `kv_connector_extra_config` with other per-put options (`preferred_segment`). Setup steps are in the usage guide's "DFS Tier" section.
- Limitations: default tenant only; `replica_num: 0` needs an unreleased Mooncake Master; one load receive thread, since concurrent GETs share the client buffer (a warning is logged otherwise); validated on a single node in `embedded` mode and in `standalone-store` mode with `enable_offload`. CI cannot run the DFS path because it needs 3FS.

With `enable_offload` and `enable_dfs` both on, this limit becomes `local_buffer_size`. But Mooncake reads the LOCAL_DISK (SSD) replica before the DFS replica, and the SSD owner buffer is only 1280 MB. So a load over 1280 MB now fails with BUFFER_OVERFLOW. Before, it was split to fit.

nodes.body: Good catch, thanks. I reproduced it on 3FS with standalone-store, enable_offload + enable_dfs and local_buffer_size=2GB: with the memory replicas evicted, a 30k-token prompt (~1.7 GB of KV) went out as one GET of 1874 keys, the owner returned BUFFER_OVERFLOW and the request failed. With both flags on, the budget is now min(local_buffer_size, 1280 MB), so the same load is split into two GETs, all keys load, and the output matches. Added a unit test and a line in the docs.

## Overview

Add an opt-in Mooncake DFS tier (e.g. 3FS) to `MooncakeStoreConnector`, so stored KV can live in a shared file system instead of, or in addition to, host memory. Builds on #42689.

## Claims

- `"enable_dfs": true` in the Mooncake config writes one DFS replica per object plus `replica_num` memory replicas (`kv_connector_extra_config`, default 1).
- `replica_num: 0` stores KV only in DFS (requires kvcache-ai/Mooncake#4637).
- Invalid setups (DFS with a non-default tenant or the cross-encoder cache, `replica_num` without DFS) fail at startup.

## Validation

- Mooncake store unit tests and pre-commit pass.
- 3FS on Mooncake main `d855a6ae`, Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct, single GPU: generate, reset the local prefix cache, generate again.

| `replica_num` | Keys with a memory replica | Store hits on 2nd request | Output tokens match |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | 0 / 33 | 528 / 537 | Yes |
| 1 | 33 / 33 | 528 / 537 | Yes |

- Limitations: default tenant only; `replica_num: 0` needs an unreleased Mooncake Master; one load receive thread, since concurrent GETs share the client buffer (a warning is logged otherwise); validated on a single node in `embedded` mode and in `standalone-store` mode with `enable_offload`.  - `tenant_id`: Optional Mooncake tenant namespace. Producers and consumers
   that should share store data must use the same tenant id. Default:
   `"default"`.
+- `enable_dfs`: When `true`, also store KV in Mooncake's shared distributed
+  file system (DFS) tier, such as 3FS. See [DFS Tier](#dfs-tier). Default:
+  `false`.
 
 Set the config path via environment variable:
 
@@ -278,6 +281,30 @@ Mooncake environment variables (`MOONCAKE_OFFLOAD_FILE_STORAGE_PATH`,
 `MOONCAKE_OFFLOAD_TOTAL_SIZE_LIMIT_BYTES`, etc.). Those are independent of
 the vLLM JSON config.
 
+### DFS Tier
+
+Mooncake can keep a replica of each object in a shared distributed file system
+(DFS) such as 3FS. Set up the Master and clients as described in the
+[Mooncake DFS deployment guide](https://github.com/kvcache-ai/Mooncake/blob/main/docs/source/deployment/mooncake-store-deployment-guide.md):
+start `mooncake_master` with `MOONCAKE_ENABLE_DFS=1`, and give the Master and
+every vLLM process the same `MOONCAKE_DFS_*` layout. vLLM processes also need
+`MOONCAKE_OFFLOAD_STORAGE_BACKEND_DESCRIPTOR=distributed_storage_backend` and
+`MOONCAKE_OFFLOAD_FILE_STORAGE_PATH` set to an existing writable directory,
+which Mooncake checks even though DFS data lives under `MOONCAKE_DFS_ROOT_DIR`.
+
+Then set `"enable_dfs": true` in the JSON config; `enable_offload` is not
+needed. Each object gets one DFS replica plus `replica_num` memory replicas,
+set in `kv_connector_extra_config` (default `1`). `replica_num: 0` stores KV
+only in DFS, so DFS eviction removes it, and needs a Mooncake Master with
+[kvcache-ai/Mooncake#4637](https://github.com/kvcache-ai/Mooncake/pull/4637).
+
+DFS supports only the default tenant and is not available to the cross-encoder
+cache. DFS loads are split to fit `local_buffer_size`, which all receive
+threads share, so keep `VLLM_MOONCAKE_LOAD_RECV_THREADS=1`. With
+`enable_offload` also set, loads are split to fit the smaller of
+`local_buffer_size` and the SSD owner's 1280 MB staging buffer, because Mooncake
+reads an SSD replica before a DFS replica.
+
 ### Tenant Isolation
 
 Set `tenant_id` in the Mooncake JSON config when different vLLM deployments should use separate Mooncake tenant namespaces:
@@ -328,6 +355,7 @@ Strict isolation requires a Mooncake master started with `--enable_multi_tenants
   incompatible with sleep mode and the CuMem allocator.
 - `cache_prefix` (str): Namespace prepended to every store key. Lets separate deployments share one Mooncake master without polluting each other — instances configured with different prefixes never see each other's cached blocks, even for identical prompts. All instances that should share a prefix cache must use the same value. Default: `""` (no prefix; keys are byte-identical to the unprefixed format).
 - `save_decode_cache` (bool): Enable offloading decode tokens' KV cache. A `kv_consumer` does not save during prefill; when decode starts, it fills any missing block-aligned prompt prefix before appending completed decode blocks. Default: `false`.
+- `replica_num` (int): Memory replicas per object when `enable_dfs` is set; `0` stores KV only in DFS. Only accepted with `enable_dfs`. Default: `1`.
 - `store_tp_size` (int): Common Store TP for divisible heterogeneous-TP
   sharing. See [Sharing one Store across multiple Prefill TP sizes](#sharing-one-store-across-multiple-prefill-tp-sizes).

inline_comments.body: With `enable_offload` and `enable_dfs` both on, this limit becomes `local_buffer_size`. But Mooncake reads the LOCAL_DISK (SSD) replica before the DFS replica, and the SSD owner buffer is only 1280 MB. So a load over 1280 MB now fails with BUFFER_OVERFLOW. Before, it was split to fit.

inline_comments.body: Good catch, thanks. I reproduced it on 3FS with standalone-store, enable_offload + enable_dfs and local_buffer_size=2GB: with the memory replicas evicted, a 30k-token prompt (~1.7 GB of KV) went out as one GET of 1874 keys, the owner returned BUFFER_OVERFLOW and the request failed. With both flags on, the budget is now min(local_buffer_size, 1280 MB), so the same load is split into two GETs, all keys load, and the output matches. Added a unit test and a line in the docs.
